name: Private Label Specialties
old_description: Uplevel Your Customer Experience & Profits With Branded Beverages.
about:
Private Label Specialties is based in Goffstown, New Hampshire, and was founded in 1991 by Ray Duhaime, who serves as president. The company began with a simple idea: offering custom-labeled sparkling water as an alternative to national brands, allowing businesses to put their own name on the bottle.

Today the company produces a line of old-fashioned beverages—including root beer, cream soda, spring water, lemonade, and eighteen other soda varieties—all custom-labeled for each client. It also operates an in-house apparel shop with screen printing, embroidery, and direct-to-garment printing, and sources over 750,000 customizable promotional products. Investments in technology have compressed the concept-to-finished-product cycle to under an hour for many orders.

The customer base spans restaurants, pizzerias, sub shops, catering companies, country stores, farm stands, and broader hospitality and service-based businesses. These clients use the branded beverages and apparel to create a memorable customer experience while generating additional revenue.

Duhaime started the business to give smaller establishments a way to market themselves without advertising for big brands. The company emphasizes a trifecta of competitive pricing, consistent quality, and responsive service—what it calls its Unique Branding Advantage—to help clients build loyalty and repeat business.
